question_text: Are you experiencing irregular or heavy periods?
suggestion_if_yes: Track cycles; discuss ovulatory dysfunction and androgen labs with a clinician.
suggestion_if_no: Continue cycle tracking; discuss other symptoms if present.

question_text: Do you notice excessive body hair growth (hirsutism) or persistent acne?
suggestion_if_yes: Ask about clinical/biochemical hyperandrogenism; consider total/free T labs.
suggestion_if_no: Monitor skin/hair changes; review other features.

question_text: Have you had recent weight gain or difficulty losing weight?
suggestion_if_yes: Screen for metabolic risk (fasting glucose/insulin, lipids); lifestyle counselling.

question_text: Any severe pelvic pain, rapid virilization (deepening voice), or pregnancy with acute symptoms?
suggestion_if_no: Proceed with PCOS work-up priorities; schedule clinician visit.

question_text: Have you ever had an ultrasound suggesting increased follicle count or ovarian volume?
suggestion_if_yes: Discuss ultrasound findings and diagnostic context; ensure differentials ruled out.

question_text: Do you have long cycles (>35 days) or <8 periods/year?
suggestion_if_yes: Document ovulatory dysfunction; discuss management options and labs.
